reason: Replace rejected oversized chibi pufferfish mascot with adult cyberpunk biker and fitted helmet.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a transparent 3x3 SPRITE ATLAS for EXE.DEV, an original human cyberpunk street fighter inspired by a pufferfish logo. CORRECTION: must look like an ADULT HUMAN in a gritty late-1990s arcade fighting game. Normal realistic adult proportions, approximately 7 heads tall. NOT chibi, NOT cute, NOT mascot, NOT bobblehead, NOT cartoon fish costume.

Character: lean adult female motorcycle street punk, wiry athletic build, full-length legs, confident severe face, short dark hair partly visible under a FITTED OPEN-FACE MOTORCYCLE HELMET. Helmet only slightly larger than a normal human head, never wider than shoulders. Worn cream/tan helmet shell, brown speckles and six SHORT rubber conical studs, subtle small fin-shaped rear vent. The pufferfish influence is subtle MATERIAL AND SHAPE LANGUAGE on real wearable motorcycle gear. NO giant fish eyes, NO fish mouth, NO giant ball, NO fins sticking out sideways. Entire human face visible in open helmet, small clear amber eye visor, cheekbones and jaw readable. Black cropped leather motorcycle jacket with cream shoulder panels, charcoal straight slim riding trousers, black lace-up ankle boots, fingerless gloves. Thin air hose from collar to helmet, tiny amber pressure gauge. Street fighter and cyberpunk bike courier. Mostly black with bone/cream helmet and small amber highlights. No fantasy armor.

Style: true sharp 16-bit arcade pixel art, visible stepped pixel contours, dark outlines and compact shading ramps, same mature human anatomical language as classic street-fighting sprites. Not smooth cartoon illustration. All nine frames same adult character, same head size and costume.

Atlas layout: exactly nine cells, strict 3 columns x 3 rows on square true-alpha transparent PNG. No background, checkerboard, scenery, floor, labels, letters, grid lines or shadows. At least 7% clear padding inside each cell. All figures fully contained, no clipping. Full body faces RIGHT three-quarter profile, consistent scale and ground baseline. Standing character about 80% of cell height. Portrait contained with padding.

Cells 1-6: six subtle CLEAN idle frames. Adult biker stands in grounded staggered fighting stance, gloved fists around chest height, modest shoulder breathing and tiny weight shift. Fitted helmet air padding expands VERY subtly, no head-size change. Keep human face clearly visible. Do not change helmet to a creature face.
Cell7 bottom left: battered defeated pose, sitting against nothing with one knee up, forearm draped on knee, head tipped down, helmet dented with flattened studs, human face annoyed and bruised with small cheek bandage, jacket scuffed. No blood.
Cell8 bottom middle: battered victory standing with arms folded and a tired smug human expression, dented fitted helmet with two tiny repair tape strips, scuffed jacket. Same adult proportions.
Cell9 bottom right: clean enlarged head-and-shoulders portrait, human adult face clearly visible through OPEN FACE fitted cream speckled motorcycle helmet with short studs, amber visor raised, black leather jacket. No injuries.
Prioritize adult cyberpunk street-fighter credibility. Pufferfish is a subtle helmet motif, NOT the character's anatomy.
